CONT-01.title: Compose PostgreSQL Volume Declaration
CONT-01.original_finding: docker-compose.yml declared postgres_data with 'external: true', causing clean checkouts without pre-created volume to fail on docker compose up.
CONT-01.implementation: Removed external: true while preserving name: medmatch_postgres_data, allowing Compose to create the volume automatically if absent or reuse an existing one.
CONT-01.validation: docker compose config passed cleanly with name: medmatch_postgres_data.
CONT-01.residual_risk: Low. Retains volume identity; safe on both clean clones and existing workstations.

CONT-02.title: Compose AI Service Healthcheck
CONT-02.original_finding: ai-service lacked a Compose healthcheck, allowing frontend to start and route traffic prematurely via service_started, generating 502 Bad Gateway errors.
CONT-02.implementation: Added container healthcheck testing /api/health/ready using python -c urllib.request (avoiding external curl/wget dependencies in python:3.12-slim). Updated frontend depends_on to condition: service_healthy.
CONT-02.validation: docker compose config passed; healthcheck parameters verified (interval: 10s, timeout: 5s, retries: 5, start_period: 40s).
CONT-02.residual_risk: Low. 40s start_period prevents premature failure during cold start on low-resource machines.

CONT-03.title: Redundant HuggingFace Model Cache Removal
CONT-03.original_finding: ai-service.Dockerfile downloaded sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in Stage 1 and copied /opt/huggingface to Stage 2, bloating image by ~100MB+ with unreferenced files (application exclusively loads /app/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2).
CONT-03.implementation: Removed build-stage HuggingFace download and Stage 2 COPY /opt/huggingface. Aligned HF_HOME and TRANSFORMERS_CACHE to /tmp/huggingface. Added --no-cache-dir to pip install.
CONT-03.validation: Zero occurrences of /opt/huggingface remain in infra/docker/. Git-tracked model directory services/ai-service/models remains intact and baked into /app/models.
CONT-03.residual_risk: Very Low. EmbeddingService loader uses local /app/models directory.

CONT-04.title: Kubernetes AI Service StartupProbe
CONT-04.original_finding: infra/kubernetes/ai-service/deployment.yaml lacked a startupProbe, exposing cold-start / slow-load pods to premature termination by livenessProbe.
CONT-04.implementation: Added startupProbe targeting /api/health/live with initialDelaySeconds: 10, periodSeconds: 5, timeoutSeconds: 5, failureThreshold: 30 (permitting up to 160s startup window). Steady-state liveness and readiness probes preserved unchanged.
CONT-04.validation: kubectl kustomize . synthesized valid manifest; kubectl apply --dry-run=client -k . confirmed deployment resource validity.
CONT-04.residual_risk: Very Low. Protects cold start without altering steady-state failure detection.

CONT-07.title: Separate Test Dependencies
CONT-07.original_finding: services/ai-service/requirements.txt declared pytest and pytest-mock, installing test tooling into production runtime images and increasing attack surface.
CONT-07.implementation: Removed pytest and pytest-mock from requirements.txt. Created requirements-dev.txt containing -r requirements.txt, pytest, and pytest-mock.
CONT-07.validation: services/ai-service/requirements.txt contains zero matches for pytest. CI workflow continues to pass compileall.
CONT-07.residual_risk: Very Low. Clean separation of test and runtime dependencies.

CONT-05.title: Consolidate Worker Image
CONT-05.original_finding: infra/docker/worker.Dockerfile duplicated 80% of ai-service.Dockerfile, resulting in build maintenance overhead and drift.
CONT-05.implementation: Deleted worker.Dockerfile. Updated .github/workflows/docker-build.yaml worker matrix to build from infra/docker/ai-service.Dockerfile. Updated docker-compose.yml celery-worker to build from ai-service.Dockerfile with explicit Celery CMD override. Maintained Kubernetes worker image identity medmatch-worker:latest.
CONT-05.validation: docker compose config passed. kubectl kustomize . passed. No active build references to deleted worker.Dockerfile remain in CI workflows.
CONT-05.residual_risk: Low. Celery command is explicitly declared in Compose and Kubernetes manifests, overriding default Uvicorn CMD.

CONT-06.title: Mutable Image Tags in Kubernetes Manifests
CONT-06.reason: Tag immutability should be addressed via CI/CD release workflow automation with Kustomize image transformers rather than hardcoding static SHAs in manifest templates.

CONT-08.title: Worker initContainer Root Permissions
CONT-08.reason: Requires coordinating PVC volume ownership, fsGroup, and storage class permissions.

CONT-10.title: Celery Solo Probe Behavior
CONT-10.reason: Probe timeouts under heavy task load require load testing and benchmarking before altering probe mechanism.
